author: Tyler Pflibsen
title: Day of Caring: A day to exercise 'North Dakota Nice' - NewsBreak
text:
By Tyler Pflibsen ,
10 hours ago
BISMARCK, ND ( KXNET ) — 'North Dakota nice' is a term often used to describe the sense of community and kindness North Dakotans have to offer. On United Way's Day of Caring, the term stands even stronger.
Missouri Slope Areawide (MSA) United Way's Day of Caring is the largest volunteer event in Bismarck-Mandan, connecting the skills and resources of community-minded individuals, businesses, and organizations to local nonprofits, schools, and parks. This year, more then 500 volunteers spent the day completing more than 50 projects throughout the Bismarck-Mandan area.
Those projects were yard work, painting at local nonprofits, preparing boxes of food for those in need, and much more.
At Bismarck High School alone, some 100 plus volunteers sorted and organized donated clothes and shoes to help less fortunate students get ready for the upcoming school year.
Executive Director with MSA United Way Jena Gullo said, "Every year Youth Works puts on we've got you covered. They have a giveaway of street clothing to any at risk youth, any youth in need, any families in need. Our Day of Caring volunteer has helped organize it and set it up."
In case you missed Day of Caring today, Gullo added there's plenty of other chances to exercise your 'North Dakota Nice' with United Way. To find out how, visit their website here to learn more.
